---
title: "10M+10H"
author: "Yvette Yan"
date: "2026-07-18"
output: html_document
---

library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(dplyr)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(htmltools)

schools_df <- read.csv("All_schools.csv", check.names = FALSE)
schools_sf <- st_as_sf(schools_df, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)

west_schools <- schools_sf %>%
  filter(lon < -76.62) %>% 
  st_transform(crs = 2248)

ms_sf <- west_schools %>% filter(School_Type == "Middle")
hs_sf <- west_schools %>% filter(School_Type == "High")

dist_mat <- st_distance(ms_sf, hs_sf)
pairs_list <- list()


n_pairs <- min(nrow(ms_sf), nrow(hs_sf)) 
for(i in 1:n_pairs) {
  min_idx <- arrayInd(which.min(dist_mat), dim(dist_mat))
  r <- min_idx[1]
  c <- min_idx[2]
  
  pairs_list[[i]] <- tibble(
    ms_index = r,
    hs_index = c,
    Combined_Score = coalesce(ms_sf$Total_Sc[r], 0) + coalesce(hs_sf$Total_Sc[c], 0)
  )
  

  dist_mat[r, ] <- NA
  dist_mat[, c] <- NA
}

pairs_df <- bind_rows(pairs_list)

top_10_pairs <- pairs_df %>%
  arrange(desc(Combined_Score)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

top_10_ms <- ms_sf[top_10_pairs$ms_index, ]
top_10_hs <- hs_sf[top_10_pairs$hs_index, ]

target_schools <- bind_rows(top_10_ms, top_10_hs) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 4326)

create_line <- function(p1, p2) {
  coords_matrix <- rbind(st_coordinates(p1), st_coordinates(p2))
  st_linestring(coords_matrix)
}

lines_sfc <- st_sfc(mapply(create_line, st_geometry(top_10_ms), st_geometry(top_10_hs), SIMPLIFY = FALSE), crs = 2248)

feeder_lines_sf <- st_sf(
  ms_name = top_10_ms$School_Name,
  hs_name = top_10_hs$School_Name,
  geometry = lines_sfc
) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 4326) 


csa_boundaries <- st_read("Baltimore_CSA.geojson") %>%
  st_transform(crs = 4326)

csa_boundaries$school_count <- lengths(st_intersects(csa_boundaries, target_schools))

csa_boundaries <- csa_boundaries %>%
  mutate(
    fill_col = case_when(
      school_count >= 3 ~ "#08519c",  
      school_count == 2 ~ "#3182bd",  
      school_count == 1 ~ "#9ecae1",  
      TRUE ~ "transparent"            
    ),
    fill_opac = ifelse(school_count == 0, 0, 0.6) 
  )

pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = c("#d93f3c", "#2e7d32"), 
  domain = c("High", "Middle")
)

interactive_map <- leaflet() %>%
  
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%

  addPolygons(data = csa_boundaries,
              fillColor = ~fill_col,        
              fillOpacity = ~fill_opac,     
              color = "#4a6fa5",            
              weight = 2,                 
              dashArray = "5, 5",         
              highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
                weight = 3,
                color = "#2c3e50",        
                fillColor = "#ffeb9b",      
                fillOpacity = 0.7,
                bringToFront = FALSE 
              ),
              label = ~CSA2020, 
              labelOptions = labelOptions(
                style = list("font-weight" = "normal", padding = "3px 8px"),
                textsize = "13px",
                direction = "auto"
              )
  ) %>%
  

  addPolylines(data = feeder_lines_sf,
               color = "gray",           
               weight = 3,               
               opacity = 0.4,            
               dashArray = "6, 6",       
               
               highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
                 color = "#ff7f00",      
                 weight = 6,             
                 opacity = 1,            
                 bringToFront = TRUE     
               ),
               label = ~paste(ms_name, "➡", hs_name) 
  ) %>%
  
  addCircleMarkers(data = target_schools,
                   color = ~pal(School_Type),
                   fillColor = ~pal(School_Type),
                   fillOpacity = 0.9,
                   radius = 6,               
                   weight = 1,
                   
  )

print(interactive_map)

saveWidget(interactive_map, "Map4_West_Baltimore_Feeder_Pairs.html")
